title: SHADOWS OF THE CRYPT
subtitle: Online
lore: Beyond the churchyard wall the dead have stopped resting. Beneath the old chapel a crypt keeps opening, and every key that fits its lock leads a little deeper into the dark.
Gather a tank, a healer and a damage dealer. Choose whose key to turn, descend, and bring back what the Hollow Steward guards. A stronger key means a harder crypt, and richer rewards.
